_description: Partial regional-price snapshot: two dated German manufacturer notebook references updated. The UK item-price confirmation and all other prices, models and recipes retain earlier source dates.
_currencyNotes: German notebook references are in EUR, with advertised 19% VAT and free shipping; each excludes a power adapter. Destination charges, stock, delivery, checkout and order acceptance are unverified.
